notices: Monitor settings for Web-based Manager access
Using wildcard characters when filtering log messages
Disk logging disabled by default on some models (Log to FortiCloud instead)
Upgrading from FortiOS v5.0 Patch Release 7 or later

observations.category: Resolved OpenSSL Issue in FortiOS v5.0 Patch Release 7
observations.description: The OpenSSL library used for the FortiOS GUI and for SSL VPN has been upgraded to the most recent version (openssl 1.0.1g). An information disclosure vulnerability has been discovered in OpenSSL version 1.0.1 up to 1.0.1f. This vulnerability may allow an attacker to access sensitive information from memory by sending crafted TLS heartbeat requests. This vulnerability has been fixed in openssl 1.0.1g.

If a link aggregation group (LAG) includes physical interfaces attached to different NP6 processors and if you apply Application Control and Traffic Shaping to the traffic using the LAG group the FortiGate CPU usage may reach 100% and the FortiGate unit may stop responding.
When the FortiGate unit is very busy with high CPU usage, IPsec VPN packets may be lost.
Traffic may not be able to pass through a VLAN interface added to a link aggregation group (LAG) in a Transparent Mode VDOM.
observations.workaround: Run diagnose sniffer packet on physical interface in TP vdom, or reboot the FortiGate unit.

observations.description: IPsec VPN traffic throughput is highly unstable.
observations.workaround: this only happens on IPsec interface added to a 40G LAG. Don't use IPsec VPN over a 40G LAG.

observations.description: TCP traffic fails to pass through inter-VDOM links when NTurbo is enabled.
observations.workaround: Disable auto-asic-offload in policies using inter-VDOM links.

observations.description: FortiGate-3700D: LAG groups configured on low latency interfaces (port25 to port32) (NP6_0 and NP6_1) do not function correctly.
observations.workaround: Only use either low-latency-mode or LAG for traffic on port25 to port32) (NP6_0 and NP6_1).

observations.description: FortiGate-3700D: LAG groups configured on low latency interfaces (port25 to port32) (NP6_0 and NP6_1) do not function correctly.
observations.workaround: Only use either low-latency-mode or LAG for traffic on port25 to port32) (NP6_0 and NP6_1).

observations.description: FortiGate-3700D: LAG groups configured on low latency interfaces (port25 to port32) (NP6_0 and NP6_1) do not function correctly.
observations.workaround: Only use either low-latency-mode or LAG for traffic on port25 to port32) (NP6_0 and NP6_1).

observations.description: IP tunneling (SIT tunnelling) not working when offload to NP6.
Reply traffic is not offloaded when shared traffic shaping is enabled on policies for accelerated inter-VDOM links using the npu_vdom interface.
Link and speed LEDs remain “ON” on after shutting down the unit after shutting down the unit using the execute shutdown command.
The r8168 driver is unable to shutdown power of the port and will keep the link of the other end in up state.
Allow option "Endpoint Registration" in VPN - SSL - Config deletes all firewall policies with srcintf "ssl.root".
nTurbo for IPS acceleration fails to accelerate traffic. Fortinet recommends keeping this option set to the default value of none. config ips global set np-accel-mode none end
Link aggregation interfaces fail to come up. All members remain in negotiating status.
Redundant interfaces do not work until the FortiGate-300D or 500D unit is rebooted.
observations.workaround: reboot the FortiGate-300D or 500D unit after adding redundant interfaces.

observations.description: Traffic may be interrupted if you have created two physical links between a managed FortiSwitch and a FortiGate acting as the manager but only configured one of the links as an aggregate link member.
observations.workaround: Remove one of the links or configure both of them.

observations.description: Application control does not always work as expected for HTTPS traffic over the explicit web proxy.
FortiGate units with NP4 processes running in Transparent Mode may experience a Transparent mode L2 loop when upgrading to FortiOS 5.0 Patch Release 6.
observations.workaround: Set the npu-vlink interface to be administratively down before upgrading to FortiOS 5.0 Patch 6. FortiOS 4.3 firmware does not support setting the npu-vlink interface down. In this case you should upgrade to a FortiOS 5.0 patch 4 and set the npu-vlink interface to be administratively down and then upgrade to FortiOS 5.0 Patch 6.

observations.description: Antivirus profile errors after upgrade from 4.3

entering an incorrect password.
